questions: Can one student borrow more than one copy of the same book at the same time, and is there a limit on how many books one student can have out?
Does the librarian need to log in, and should students identify themselves only by typing their name, or do they need a login too? What if two students have the same name?
Should the librarian also be able to edit or remove a book, or change the number of copies after adding it, and is there a due date or history of past loans to track?
answers: No, they just give their name.
